## Summary

Describe the user-visible or contributor-visible outcome.

## Verification

List the focused checks and manual qualification performed.

## Public documentation hygiene

- [ ] Every new root-level or `docs/` Markdown file has a defined public audience and purpose.
- [ ] No internal design rationale, audit evidence, release runbook, rehearsal material, or private-repository content is included.
- [ ] New, moved, or renamed public Markdown files are reflected in `config/public-documents.json`.
